services.desc: Scallop with the best and the most experienced Captain/Guide and “The Undisputed Scallop King of Citrus County” Enjoy a scenic ride out the Homosassa River to the BEST scalloping grounds in the state. Every year, from July 1st to September 25th, seafood lovers from all over the Sunshine State and beyond venture to Citrus County for these tasty morsels. Snorkel in crystal clear water usually waist or chest deep over pristine grass flats and bag your limit of these delicious shellfish. Scalloping is part snorkeling experience, part treasure dive and part saltwater fishing experience that can be enjoyed by family members of all ages. blurb: Red Ed's Adventures offers fishing charters on the Homosassa, Chassahowitzka, and Crystal Rivers, known for their pristine waterways and abundant gamefish species. They provide full day and half day fishing charters as well as all-inclusive lodge vacations. The business serves individual, medium, and large group charters anywhere in Florida.

quotes.author: Steve F.
quotes.text: What an amazing experience! "I booked a half day scalloping trip for four people, including my 6-year-old granddaughter. It was super easy to book, and I got warm, friendly service. What an amazing experience! We all had a blast, and we got the grand tour of Monkey Island! Ed knows where the scallops are, it's a beautiful ride out from the marina, and you just can't ask for a better way to spend the day! Thank you Ed. You're not just a great Captain with a wonderful setup, you are a memory maker. Luna will always remember her first of many trips. We look forward to the next time!

quotes.author: Erin S.
quotes.text: Highly recommend using this charter! "My family and I just went scalloping with Red Ed’s Adventure and can’t say enough good things about Captain Ed and Bo. Both captains were professional, kind and very helpful since some of us had never scalloped before. They were both great with kids and made us all feel very safe. We would all highly recommend using this charter and we will definitely be using them again in the future.

quotes.author: Christine P.
quotes.text: Captain Red Ed is awesome! "It was a foggy start to our day but he navigated thru it and put us on fish! He has great equipment, knows the waterways, and we always have a great time with him. Can’t wait to go again!
